quotes: Operational privacy — object auth, file layout, batch jobs, IFS flows, and audit journal.
Privacy officers ask for data inventories. On IBM i, the inventory starts at DSPFD and DSPFFD, not a cloud console.

steps.title: Display object authority on PAYMST
excerptRefs: Operational privacy — object auth, file layout, batch jobs, IFS flows, and audit journal.

steps.title: Display file description — SSN field
excerptRefs: Privacy officers ask for data inventories. On IBM i, the inventory starts at DSPFD and DSPFFD, not a cloud console.
ISO 27701 Clause 8: prove you know which native files store personal data before you attest processing controls.

steps.title: Field-level PII inventory — DSPFFD
excerptRefs: Privacy officers ask for data inventories. On IBM i, the inventory starts at DSPFD and DSPFFD, not a cloud console.
steps.exitHint: Option 5 on a field for detail; F3 when done.

steps.title: Work with job schedule entries
excerptRefs: PII processing on IBM i is often batch: nightly close, weekly extracts, IFS exports. WRKJOBSCDE is where those schedules live.

steps.title: IFS payroll path
excerptRefs: The Clause 8 article names IFS data flows. paymst.sym points at PAYROLL/PAYMST.
Privacy impact: native authority + IFS path + batch export = full data-flow evidence chain.

steps.title: Display audit journal
excerptRefs: Audit journal review is the bridge between IT operations and assurance. You are not done when you saw a screen. You ask what got logged when someone changed it.
steps.exitHint: Press F3 to exit the journal.
